mapper.sql: select id, ding_corp_id, corp_name, contact_user, contact_phone, status, ext1, ext2, ext3, create_time, update_time from ding_tenant

select * from ( select t.*, p.product_name as package_name, usage_log.last_used_time, case when s.id is null then 'UNSUBSCRIBED' when s.status = 3 then 'CANCELLED' when s.status = 2 then 'RENEWAL_DUE' when s.start_time > NOW() then 'PENDING' when s.end_time <= DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) then 'RENEWAL_DUE' when s.start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) then 'NEW' else 'ACTIVE' end as tenant_type from ding_tenant t left join ding_subscription s on s.ding_corp_id = t.ding_corp_id left join ding_product p on p.id = s.product_id left join ( select ding_corp_id, max(used_at) as last_used_time from ( select ding_corp_id, max(occurred_at) as used_at from ding_api_call_log where platform = 'DING' and api_name = 'records' group by ding_corp_id union all select ding_corp_id, max(started_at) as used_at from ding_sync_execution group by ding_corp_id union all select ding_corp_id, max(create_time) as used_at from ding_sync_log group by ding_corp_id ) usage_sources group by ding_corp_id ) usage_log on usage_log.ding_corp_id = t.ding_corp_id ) enterprise
